top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation by induced proximity is a transferable molecular design rule: a heterobifunctional molecule recruits a chosen protein to an E3 ligase, and changing the warhead changes the target. Crews and Deshaies conceived the concept and Ciulli's structure-guided ligands and ternary-complex work made it a rigorous design problem; reproduction is broad and degraders are in clinical trials. I accept that the missing drug approval and the molecular-glue credit boundary are real weaknesses, so P001 is a close second: Buchwald-Hartwig C-N coupling is undisputed in maturity and attribution, and distinct from the 2010 prize, but narrower in conceptual reach. Any award is preferred to no award.
